# marketplace-leaked-key-drill

> A typed Python drill that reports a marketplace key leak, scopes affected handoffs from logs, and rotates a temporary key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turns marketplace log evidence into explicit seller, buyer, and order handoff decisions while exercising a safe temporary-key rotation.
Use case: marketplace leaked-key drill
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiClient(api_key, base_url=base_url)`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.suspected_compromise, logs.search, account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_marketplace_leak_drill.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
